profile_text.body:
SpaceX, formally SPACE EXPLORATION TECHNOLOGIES CORP, describes itself on its site as a company that designs, manufactures and launches advanced rockets and spacecraft. It says it was founded in 2002 to revolutionize space technology, with the stated ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets. The site text repeats the design, manufacturing and launch description without naming specific vehicles, programs or services.

The company is recorded as a public company trading under the ticker SPCX, with CIK 0001181412 and headquarters in Starbase, Texas. It also appears under the alias SPACE EXPLORATION TECHN-CL A. The material available does not identify AI products or describe an AI position for the company.

Its legal exposure is recorded in Texas, where 125 matters are noted. No individual cases are listed.
